nodes.purpose: Compute plain_gram = M M^T by multiplying the 3x9 M by its explicitly constructed 9x3 transpose; the rounded printed vectors are used as data with no orthonormalization.

Compute the ascending spectrum of plain_gram as its three real eigenvalues (returned already sorted ascending), i.e. plain_spectrum.

nodes.object: Ascending spectrum of the weighted Gram matrix

deliverables.description: All scientific values are parsed by read-only parsers from the single bundled completed water Q-Chem output bound from task inputs; no new quantum-chemistry calculation is run and no Materials Project identity is assigned.
frequencies and ir_intensities are the parsed three-element arrays in printed mode order (cm^-1 and km/mol respectively).
The three printed mode displacement tensors form the 3x9 matrix M with rows in printed mode order and columns in atom-major [atom0 x,y,z, atom1 x,y,z, atom2 x,y,z] order.
plain_gram is the reported 3x3 matrix product M M^T computed directly from the parsed M.
weighted_gram is the reported 3x3 matrix product (M D)(M D)^T with D=diag(4,4,4,1,1,1,1,1,1) applied as explicit column factors.
plain_spectrum and weighted_spectrum are the ascending eigenvalue sets of plain_gram and weighted_gram respectively, as returned by the symmetric eigendecomposition.
intensity_fractions is proportions[0] of the row-normalized IR intensities, i.e. each intensity divided by the sum of the three, in printed mode order.
No node rescales, orthogonalizes or renormalizes the rounded printed displacement vectors; both Gram matrices and their spectra are computed directly from the parsed coordinates.

deliverables.description: All scientific values are parsed by read-only parsers from the single bundled completed water Q-Chem output bound from task inputs; no new quantum-chemistry calculation is run and no Materials Project identity is assigned.
frequencies and ir_intensities are the parsed three-element arrays in printed mode order (cm^-1 and km/mol respectively).

The parser's 3x3x3 mode displacement tensor is explicitly flattened into the 3x9 matrix M by mode_matrix, with rows in printed mode order and columns in atom-major [atom0 x,y,z, atom1 x,y,z, atom2 x,y,z] order; no normalization or orthogonalization is applied.
plain_gram is the reported 3x3 matrix product M M^T computed from the explicitly flattened 3x9 M.
weighted_gram is the reported 3x3 matrix product (M D)(M D)^T with D=diag(4,4,4,1,1,1,1,1,1) applied as explicit column factors to the flattened M.
plain_spectrum and weighted_spectrum are the ascending eigenvalue sets of plain_gram and weighted_gram respectively, as returned by the symmetric eigendecomposition.
intensity_fractions is proportions[0] of the row-normalized IR intensities, i.e. each intensity divided by the sum of the three, in printed mode order.

No node rescales, orthogonalizes or renormalizes the rounded printed displacement vectors beyond the explicitly declared metric weighting; both Gram matrices and their spectra are computed directly from the parsed coordinates.
